QUOTE: Default (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off) | Macros to libc `calloc` / `free`... The static pointer defaults to `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC`. That macro is off in the shipped config (`mbedtls_config.h:4124`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY gates the hooks, but it never says that this macro is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h. The shipped-config claim is made about MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC instead.
